```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(leaflet)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(htmltools)

options(tidyverse.quiet = TRUE)

source("pir_source.R")

hs_palette <- c("#e51937","#0063a6","#fff13b","#499f68","#84dcc6","#693668","#373d20","#717744")
```

## Bilingual Teachers in MA in 2024

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total number of childcare workers and pre-k and kindergarten teachers that speak a language other than English in MA (estimate)"

teacher_lang_summary <- ma_pums_recoded |>
  filter(OCCP == 2300 | OCCP == 4600) |>
  filter(LANX == 1) |>
  summarize(prop = n() / 623)

teacher_summary <- ma_pums_recoded |>
  filter(OCCP == 2300 | OCCP == 4600) |>
  summarize(prop = n() / 74617)

total_teacher_est <- total_pop_ma$estimate[[1]] * teacher_summary$prop

total_bilingual_teacher_est <- total_teacher_est * teacher_lang_summary$prop * 100

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = round(total_bilingual_teacher_est)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Proportion of childcare workers and pre-k and kindergarten teachers that speak a language other than English in MA"

teacher_lang_percent <- teacher_lang_summary$prop * 100

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(teacher_lang_percent, 2)
)
```

## Head Start Bilingual Teachers, MA, 2024
```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Number of Biliingual Teachers, Assistant Teachers, Home Visitors, and FCC Providers at Head Start in MA"

bilingual_hs <- pir_b |>
  filter(State == "MA") |>
  filter(pir_year == 2024) |>
  summarize(bilingual_teachers = sum(B.14))

list(
  icon = "hash",
  color = "info",
  value = bilingual_hs$bilingual_teachers
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Precent of Teachers, Assistant Teachers, Home Visitors, and FCC Providers That Are Bilingual at Head Start in MA"

hs_staff_summary <- pir_b |>
  filter(State == "MA") |>
  filter(pir_year == 2024) |>
  summarize(bilingual_teachers_etc = sum(B.14, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_preschool_classroom = sum(`B.3-1`, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_preschool_asst = sum(`B.3-2`, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_infant_toddler_teacher = sum(B.6, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_home_visitor = sum(B.8, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_FCC = sum(B.9, na.rm = TRUE),
            denom = (total_preschool_classroom + total_preschool_asst + total_infant_toddler_teacher + total_home_visitor + total_FCC),
            percent_bilingual_teachers_etc = bilingual_teachers_etc / denom)


list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(hs_staff_summary$percent_bilingual_teachers_etc, 2)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Proportion of childcare workers and pre-k and kindergarten teachers that speak a language other than English employed at Head Start in MA"

prop_at_hs <- bilingual_hs$bilingual_teachers / total_bilingual_teacher_est

list(
  icon = "percent",
  color = "info",
  value = round(prop_at_hs, 2)
)
```

## Temporal Visualizations
```{r}
# for total in ma, acs1 vs acs5? and 2020 isn't in acs1
```


```{r}
#| fill: false
ma_earlyed_2024 <- ma_pums_recoded |>
  filter(OCCP == 2300 | OCCP == 4600)
ma_earlyed_2023 <- ma_pums_2023 |>
  filter(OCCP == 2300 | OCCP == 4600)
ma_earlyed_2022 <- ma_pums_2022 |>
  filter(OCCP == 2300 | OCCP == 4600)
ma_earlyed_2021 <- ma_pums_2021 |>
  filter(OCCP == 2300 | OCCP == 4600)

summary_2021 <- ma_earlyed_2021 |>
  filter(LANX == 1) |>
  summarize(prop = n()/ 581 * 100)
summary_2022 <- ma_earlyed_2022 |>
  filter(LANX == 1) |>
  summarize(prop = n()/ 614 * 100)
summary_2023 <- ma_earlyed_2023 |>
  filter(LANX == 1) |>
  summarize(prop = n()/ 580 * 100)
summary_2024 <- ma_earlyed_2021 |>
  filter(LANX == 1) |>
  summarize(prop = n()/ 623 * 100)

ma_multilang_temporal <- data.frame(
  year = c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024),
  prop_multilingual = c(summary_2021$prop, summary_2022$prop, summary_2023$prop, summary_2024$prop) 
)

ma_multilang_temporal |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, 
             y = prop_multilingual)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,50)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = hs_palette) +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "% Multilingual Early Educator",
       title = "About 1 in 4 Early Educators in MA Speak Another Language") +
  theme_minimal()  +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(prop_multilingual, 2)), 
            vjust = 1)
```

```{r}
#| fill: false
pir_b |>
  filter(State == "MA") |>
  group_by(pir_year) |>
  summarize(bilingual_teachers_etc = sum(B.14, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_preschool_classroom = sum(`B.3-1`, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_preschool_asst = sum(`B.3-2`, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_infant_toddler_teacher = sum(B.6, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_home_visitor = sum(B.8, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_FCC = sum(B.9, na.rm = TRUE),
            denom = (total_preschool_classroom + total_preschool_asst + total_infant_toddler_teacher + total_home_visitor + total_FCC),
            percent_bilingual_teachers_etc = bilingual_teachers_etc / denom * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pir_year, y = percent_bilingual_teachers_etc)) +
  geom_line(color = "#E51937") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = min(pir_a$pir_year):max(pir_a$pir_year)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(25, 75)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Percent of Multilingual Staff*", 
       title = "Nearly Half of Head Start Staff* are Multilingual",
       subtitle = "Head Start Program Information Report, MA, 2021-2025",
       caption = "*'Staff' includes teachers, assistant teachers, home visitors, and family childcare providers") +
  theme_minimal()
```
